scope: Theorem 1.2 (Uniform commutator estimate) of the manuscript “Kadison's similarity theorem through uniform derivation estimates” (preprints/Kadisons-similarity-theorem-through-uniform-derivation-estimates-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 288 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c1ce1a87b049839), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute constant C < ∞ such that, for every complex Hilbert space K, every unital von Neumann algebra P ⊂ B(K), every Y ∈ B(K), every integer h ≥ 1, and every X ∈ Mh(P), ∥[Y(h) , X]∥ ≤ C gP(Y) ∥X∥. (1) Here Mh(P) acts naturally on Kh, and [T, U] = TU − UT.
